import json, re, csv, sys

src = sys.argv[1]
dst = sys.argv[2]

OUTAGE = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(down|outage|cannot log in|kan niet inloggen)(?!\w)", re.I)
INVOICE = re.compile(r"(?<!\w)(invoice|factuur|refund)(?!\w)", re.I)

rows = []
with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        t = json.loads(line)
        if t["status"] == "closed":
            continue
        text = t["subject"] + " " + t["body"]
        if t["email"].endswith("@acme-intern.be"):
            p = "P4"
        elif OUTAGE.search(text):
            p = "P1" if t["plan"] == "enterprise" else "P2"
        elif INVOICE.search(text):
            p = "P3"
        else:
            p = "P4"
        rows.append((t["id"], p))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
with open(dst, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["id", "priority"])
    w.writerows(rows)
print(len(rows), "rows written")
EOF
